cands.name: Jeff Sorrells

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 87, in office since 2018. Banker: vice president and lender at First National Bank of Hartford. Former mayor of Hartford, Alabama. Troy University graduate.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Sorrells was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools. The sponsored-legislation list on his Ballotpedia page was empty, so we could not confirm any bills he sponsored. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties. The dates of his term as mayor of Hartford were not available.

qual.background: Has served in the Alabama House since 2018, was previously mayor of Hartford, Alabama, and worked as vice president and lender at First National Bank of Hartford. He holds a Troy University B.A. and attended Samford's Community Bankers School of Banking.
qual.why: Roughly seven years of legislative service plus local elected office as mayor and a banking and lending career put him in the high range. Committee seats were not counted.
